component.name: PortalItem
component.script:
sub init() m.background = m.top.findNode("background") m.icon = m.top.findNode("icon") m.itemLabel = m.top.findNode("itemLabel") end sub
sub onContentChange() item = m.top.itemContent if item = invalid then return
title = item.title m.itemLabel.text = title
t = LCase(title) if Instr(1, t, "buscar") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/search.png" else if Instr(1, t, "película") > 0 or Instr(1, t, "pelicula") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/film.png" else if Instr(1, t, "serie") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/series.png" else if Instr(1, t, "dorama") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/doramas.png" else if Instr(1, t, "anime") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/animes.png" else if Instr(1, t, "cable") > 0 or Instr(1, t, "canal") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/tv.png" else if Instr(1, t, "país") > 0 or Instr(1, t, "pais") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/globe.png" else if Instr(1, t, "instruc") > 0 m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/info.png" else m.icon.uri = "pkg:/images/icons/film.png" end if end sub
sub onFocusChange() if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.background.color = "0x7B4DFFFF" m.itemLabel.color = "0xFFFFFFFF" else m.background.color = "0x1E2433FF" m.itemLabel.color = "0xEEEEEEFF" end if end sub
